title: Controlling the number of branches of the fibres by the normalisation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma relates the number of local branches of the fibres of a morphism to the number of points of the normalisation lying over the corresponding point, and shows the count is controlled in a neighbourhood. The proof analyses the normalisation morphism locally over the base, counts the points of the normalisation over a given point using that the normalisation is finite over a locally Noetherian base, and then spreads the count to a neighbourhood by upper semicontinuity of the fibre cardinality for a finite morphism. The spreading argument is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10354-10402.
